list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A mononuclear Yb(III) complex with two Cp* ligands, one terminal fluoride, and coordinated diethyl ether. The crystallographic Yb–F distance is 2.015(4) Å.

synthesis.procedure: Separately cooled ether solutions of YbCp*2·OEt2 and perfluoro-2,3-dimethylpent-2-ene were combined at −25 °C. The mixture warmed to 25 °C over 30 min and was evaporated to dryness.
synthesis.temperature: −25 °C initially; warmed to 25 °C over 30 min; crystallized at −25 °C
synthesis.time: 30 min warming; about 2 days for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The residue was dissolved in 2 mL ether and cooled to −25 °C. Red-orange crystals were isolated by decantation and dried under vacuum; a second crop was obtained from the supernatant.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A mononuclear Yb(III) complex with two Cp* ligands, one terminal fluoride, and coordinated THF. Its YbCp*2F core is similar to that of the diethyl ether adduct; the crystallographic Yb–F distance is 2.026(2) Å.

synthesis.procedure: The diethyl ether adduct YbCp*2F·OEt2 was dissolved in THF and evaporated to dryness, giving the THF adduct as an orange-red powder.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After evaporation to dryness, the product was recrystallized by cooling a saturated toluene solution to −25 °C.
synthesis.yield: Described as quantitative; no numerical yield reported

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The five trivalent ytterbium atoms form a capped-butterfly arrangement: a YbCp*2 unit caps four YbCp* vertices. All nine fluorides bridge ytterbium atoms, comprising six μ2, two μ3, and one μ4 fluoride. The crystal is a toluene solvate.

synthesis.procedure: Approximately one equivalent of perfluoro-2,4-dimethyl-3-ethylpent-2-ene was added to a green solution of YbCp*2·OEt2 in toluene. The resulting orange solution was left at ambient temperature for nine weeks.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Small red crystals precipitated from the toluene reaction solution and were collected for X-ray crystallography.
synthesis.yield: About 80 mg of crystals; reaction not optimized
